test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’.**

Often we __ourselves__ are responsible for our ill health.
solution: The correct answer is** 'No improvement required'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically correct. • Reflexive pronouns are words like** myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, and themselves.** • They refer back to a person or thing. • We often use **reflexive pronouns** when the **subject** and the **object** of a **verb** are the same. • Hence, in the given sentence no improvement is required. **Correct Sentence:__** *Often we **ourselves** are responsible for our ill health.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से सही है। • **Reflexive Pronouns** शब्द हैं, **myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, and themselves**। • **Reflexive Pronouns** किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु को वापस संदर्भित करते हैं। • हम अक्सर **Reflexive Pronouns **का उपयोग करते हैं जब **verb** का **subject** और **object** समान होती है। • अतः दिए गए वाक्य में किसी सुधार की आवश्यकता नहीं है। bc:Tad1, The correct answer is '**DBAC**'.
